en.hubeali:
Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A right of Ibrahimas in Makkah was between Al-Hazourat to the Mas’a (area of Sa’ee). So that is which was its line (boundary), meaning the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 10. Fadalah ibn Ayyub has narrated from ‘ Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The right of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam was from al- Hazwarah to al-Mas‘a’; so it is the quarter which Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam had marked, that is, the area of the Masjid.’”
